folders.description: Why the project exists: goals, scope, stakeholders and constraints.
folders.conventions: Keep these notes short and current; change them when the scope changes.

folders.description: One note per decision: context, options, choice, consequences.
folders.conventions: Name the note after the decision; state the date and who decided; link the notes that informed it.
folders.examples: Adopt PostgreSQL as the default database.
folders.anti_examples: Meeting minutes (they go in Meetings/ and link to the decision).

folders.description: One note per meeting: date, attendees, what was discussed and agreed.
folders.conventions: Name notes YYYY-MM-DD plus topic; link to decisions made instead of restating them.
folders.anti_examples: Decisions with their reasoning (they go in Decisions/).

folders.description: External material the project relies on: specs, articles, vendor docs.
folders.conventions: One note per source with a summary and the link; cite it from other notes.
folders.anti_examples: Our own decisions (they go in Decisions/).

folders.description: Project vocabulary: one note per term, with the agreed meaning.
folders.conventions: File name is the term; first line is the definition.
folders.anti_examples: Long explanations (link to Context/ or References/).

folders.conventions: Move notes here instead of deleting them.
